rows.grounds: adverbial accusative indicating initial stage in sequence
compound: ādhāra-yuga-patraka; object of immersion process described in prior verse

items.question: Which locus is engaged first in the immersion within suṣumnā?
premises: The yogin immerses awareness in suṣumnā.
The action proceeds in an ordered sequence.
The first locus named is the support-pair-petal.
items.inference: The initial stage of immersion in suṣumnā engages the support-pair-petal.
uncertainties: The precise anatomical or subtle referent of ādhārayugapatrakam is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O supreme goddess, first the support-pair-petal.
